search_clinical_trials.title: Synthetic test record: oral therapy in adults with a chronic condition
search_clinical_trials.brief_summary: Synthetic record used only to test how an assistant reads truncated eligibility text.
search_clinical_trials.inclusion_criteria: Adults aged 18 to 75 years; confirmed diagnosis; able to take oral medication.
